newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Power Hatch 1 power unit at 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Power Hatch 1 power unit at 100 pct.

text.p: Georgia Power Co's 741 megawatt (MW) Hatch 1 nuclear power unit has resumed full output after restarting over the weekend, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday in its plant status report.
The unit, in Baxley, Ga., was taken off line last Wednesday when a small leak was found in a three-quarter inch line inside the drywell building that houses the reactor.
The unit was operating at about 30 percent of capacity early Monday.
The adjacent unit, with a generating capacity of 765 MW, is operating at full power.
Georgia Power is a subsidiary of Southern Co.
